pages.text: Several mods add big, named fights with their own arenas and unique drops. Most bosses are found in a dedicated structure or summoned with a special item. This page is the index; each mod has its own entry.

$(li)$(l:exploration/cataclysm)Cataclysm$(/l): about a dozen bosses across all biomes.$(li)$(l:exploration/mowzies_mobs)Mowzie's Mobs$(/l): the Wroughtnaut, Umvuthi, Frostmaw and the Sculptor.$(li)$(l:exploration/twilight_forest)Twilight Forest$(/l): eight bosses with trophies.$(li)$(l:ocean/aquamirae)Aquamirae$(/l): the Ice Maze trio.
Pack tuning: Cataclysm's main bosses and all four Mowzie's bosses have 0.7x health and 0.75x damage. They are softened, not removed, and every boss structure still generates.

Others: the $(l:exploration/aether)Aether$(/l) dungeons end in the Slider, Valkyrie Queen and Sun Spirit. Hybrid Aquatic has the Karkinos. $(l:exploration/magic)Iron's Spells$(/l) has the Dead King and a Citadel. Vanilla Wither, Dragon and Elder Guardian also remain.

Boss drops often upgrade existing gear, so keep your best weapons around. In this pack the Cataclysm boss gear has Create-flavoured recipes: see $(l:exploration/cataclysm_create)Cataclysm x Create$(/l).

pages.title: Nether Star
pages.text: The Wither's drop goes into Create Nuclear's Reactor Controller and the $(l:stars/stellar_core)Stellar Core$(/l).
